Bettina Kroll: the Moss digest dated Nov 2, 2025 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics' account ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03", so the date is **November 3, 2025**.

The digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner. The cheat sheet does list PHL as a Coastal account, but it doesn't say who took it over. If the tracker needs that confirmed, check with Kwame.

Be careful not to mix this up with Covey & Lark Retail. It also uses the "PHL" shorthand.
